question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are friends and avid readers who occasionally trade books. At the start of the semester, they each buy one new book: Alice gets The Trial, Bob gets Dune, and Claire gets Beloved.
As the semester proceeds, they start trading around the new books. First, Claire and Bob swap books. Then, Claire and Bob swap books. Finally, Claire and Bob swap books. At the end of the semester, Claire has
Options:
(A) The Trial
(B) Dune
(C) Beloved
solution:
Book order in every row: Alice | Bob | Claire.
Initial: The Trial | Dune | Beloved
1. Claire and Bob swap: The Trial | Beloved | Dune
2. Claire and Bob swap: The Trial | Dune | Beloved
3. Claire and Bob swap: The Trial | Beloved | Dune
Claire has Dune, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
